c: uv run python run_load.py   # the folder has 9 files
q: How many documents does the loader return, and why not 9?
o: 6: the others are bad, empty, duplicate or unsupported
why: Four files were skipped, each with a warning that names the file and the reason.

c:
faq-battery.txt and faq-battery2.txt have the same text
# files are read in alphabetical order
q: Which one is skipped as a duplicate?
why: The loader keeps the first copy it meets and skips the rest. The order is alphabetical.

q: The file contains {"title": "Oops", and nothing else. What happens?
why: Without the try, one broken file stops everything. That is why load_folder catches the errors it expects.

q: The file bom.txt starts with an invisible byte order mark. What do you see?
o: '\ufeffWarranty': the mark stays in the title
why: utf-8-sig reads the file as UTF-8 and drops the mark. Without it a search for Warranty would not match.

q: What does the loader do with the empty file?
o: Skips it: the empty title fails the Document check
Returns a Document with an empty body
why: A Document needs a non-empty doc_id, title and body, so the check at the door rejects it and the loader moves on.
The byte 0xe9 is a Latin-1 letter, not valid UTF-8. The loader does not catch this error yet: it is one more file problem to expect.
